answer_1.quote: we use a short-term visual captioner coupled with an LLM... we propose a multi-round summarization prompt that asks the LLM first to summarize the short-term visual captions and then answer a given question...
answer_1.outputs: Short video clip captions, video summaries, and multiple-choice answers

answer_2.quote: We use QA accuracy (i.e., the percentage of correctly answered questions) as our evaluation metric... The metrics we used include: 1) Intersection over Prediction (IoP)... 2) temporal Intersection over Union (IoU), and 3) Acc@GQA...
